rationale: The packet grounds that Part I Outfall 001 lists Ceriodaphnia dubia WET with VALUE 'Report' (not a numeric discharge limit), frequency 'Once/5 years', sample type '24-Hr Composite', under the '7-Day Chronic Static Renewal/NOEC' header, with footnote (2) requiring testing at first discharge and footnote (3) deferring WET requirements to Part II. That supports distinguishing this row as report-only within Part I, but it does not establish whether the permit as a whole imposes an enforceable numeric compliance limit (Part II text is absent), nor does it supply discharge-occurrence history or Part II conditions needed to determine all monitoring trigger windows or to classify periods lacking a reported WET result. Neither the burden to ACCEPT a complete permit-wide limit-and-applicability resolution nor the burden to REJECT it is met; uncertainty is left open rather than closed from absence.
